from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.job_tracker = LifespanJobTracker()
    yield

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/jobs")

@router.get("/{job_id}/results")
async def get_rendered_job_results(
    job_id: str,
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    tracker: LifespanJobTracker = request.app.state.job_tracker
    job_record = tracker.lookup_job(job_id)
    if not job_record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found in lifespan tracker")
    if job_record.user_id != user.id and not user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user does not own this rendering job")

    return {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "status": job_record.status,
        "artifacts": job_record.output_urls,
        "render_stats": job_record.statistics
    }
